flagged.title: No official NFL betting price exists for any market
flagged.detail: The NFL publishes no odds anywhere on nfl.com, so opener/closer/market_line/difference are blank on every market in the price snapshot store and originated lines. Nothing is inferred.
flagged.consequence: Gate G7 (executable price) blocked permanently; ROI is computable only at an assumed -110 and is labelled as such; 0 rewards awarded.

flagged.title: No official depth chart, so no 1st/2nd/3rd/4th-string label
flagged.detail: nfl.com/depth-charts/ returns a 404 'Flag on the Play' page (re-checked 2026-11-14). The NFL publishes no snap counts either. A string label produced today would be invented, so none is published.
flagged.consequence: Requirement R06 (track replacement depth) can only be met via official game-status designations; string depth is blocked.

flagged.title: Week 10 injury capture is partial (3 of 8 nfl.com chunks)
flagged.detail: Designations below cover WAS-NYG, NE-DET, KC-ATL, MIN-GB, JAX-TEN, BUF-NYJ, MIA-IND (partial). Games CAR-NO, SF-DAL, PIT-CIN, LAC-BAL, LAR-ARI were not reached.
flagged.consequence: The injury tracker is not a full Week 10 census; flagged rather than completed.

flagged.title: No measured conversion from 'player out' to points
flagged.detail: No official conversion exists; it needs snap counts and per-player value, neither published. The band (0.25/0.50/1.00 pts per OUT/Doubtful/Questionable) is a disclosed assumption.
flagged.consequence: Injury adjustment published as a band beside each line, never as a point estimate (F-05).

flagged.title: Injury sensitivity band is an assumption, not a measured effect
flagged.detail: The official injury report gives a game status (OUT/DOUBTFUL/QUESTIONABLE) but not whether the player is a starter or how many snaps they would take. The published line is the no-adjustment line.
flagged.consequence: No precision is claimed; the band is the honest ceiling (R06/R12 partial).

flagged.title: No official per-game player log; no SGP price
flagged.detail: nfl.com/stats/ is client-rendered and no official download feed was established. No archived same-game-parlay price exists. C6 and C8 correlations are blank.
flagged.consequence: Prop-combo strategies are blocked from the leaderboard; cross-game parlays use measured near-zero independence only.

flagged.title: One completed Week 10 game; no meaningful backtest sample
flagged.result: G1 (300-game floor) fails; all ROI/hit-rate fields blank or not meaningful; 0 strategies qualify.
flagged.consequence: No edge is claimed; this snapshot demonstrates the method, not performance.

flagged.title: Sixteen NFL namespaces overlap in this repository
flagged.detail: Four publish own lines, five publish questions, six publish suggestions; a reader cannot tell which is current.
flagged.consequence: Consolidation is suggestion S10 and needs a decision; not a defect of this namespace's data.
